status: Preexisting pilot; declared alongside its fixtures and code, not independently preregistered or sprint-period research
unit: One authored packet plus an identical anchor selection for all three policies

policies.quote_only: Resolve the same selected anchor IDs and release their quote strings without checking sources, offsets, source text or labels. This is a deliberately weak engineered comparator, not a real system or LLM.
policies.exact_span_only: Use the production validate_packet and selection functions over the whole packet, then release selected exact quotes without the disagreement-label gate.
policies.full_gate: Use the same production validation and selection, then production build_note including the whole-packet user-label disagreement gate. No oracle fields enter any policy.

oracle: Independent author expectations are stored explicitly per synthetic case, not derived by the scorer from the packet's position labels. selected_spans_valid concerns selected citations; review_required is the author's scenario-level expectation of a manual hold, not factual truth or semantic entailment.

metrics.invalid_selected_citation_release: Cases released with author-marked invalid selected citation / all cases marked invalid selected citation. Measures structural citation defects only.
metrics.required_review_miss: Cases released despite an independent author expectation of manual review / all author-marked review-required cases. No semantic-truth or LLM claim.
metrics.eligible_quote_withheld: Cases withheld with valid selected spans and no independent review requirement / all cases with valid selected spans and no review requirement. Includes conservative rejection because an unselected anchor is invalid.
metrics.input_rejected_cases: Raw case count rejected by input validation; separate from annotation holds.
metrics.annotation_hold_cases: Raw case count withheld by the full-packet disagreement-label rule.
metrics.reporting: Publish every case and n/N; zero denominator means rate null and display N/A. Metrics use different possibly overlapping subsets, not a summed accuracy score.

limitations: Sixteen small authored synthetic cases are a mechanism pilot, not a representative dataset, held-out evaluation, model-performance estimate or statistical generalization.
No LLM, Otari, external search or human participant is used. No claim is made about semantic truth, entailment, decision quality or source reliability.
The author oracle is a declared test intention and may be wrong; it was not independently expert-annotated, blinded or adjudicated.
The quote-only comparator is deliberately weak. Both stronger policies validate the entire packet; this controls their ablation but does not represent every plausible citation system.
Wrong or missing human labels can hide a needed review; different labels on compatible text can cause a false hold. These cases remain visible rather than relabeled to make the full gate win.
Whole-packet validation and holds can suppress an otherwise uncontested selected quote. A later study should measure this cost with independently authored real tasks and annotations.
Version 1.0.0 and all present results were created on 2026-11-05 before the Apart sprint. New sprint work and the required research report remain undone.
